import time
import numpy as np
from task import motion_mask, synthetic

def reference(t, xyz, enter_speed=0.08, exit_speed=0.04, hold_seconds=0.12):
    t = np.ascontiguousarray(t, dtype=np.float64)
    xyz = np.ascontiguousarray(xyz, dtype=np.float64)
    n = len(t)
    mask = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int32)
    if n < 2:
        return mask
    speed = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xyz, axis=0), axis=1) / np.diff(t)
    candidate = -1
    active = False
    for i, current_speed in enumerate(speed, start=1):
        if active:
            if current_speed < exit_speed:
                active = False
                candidate = -1
            else:
                mask[i] = 1
        elif current_speed < enter_speed:
            candidate = -1
        else:
            if candidate < 0:
                candidate = i
            if t[i] - t[candidate] >= hold_seconds:
                active = True
                mask[i] = 1
    return mask

t, xyz = synthetic()
start = time.perf_counter()
got = motion_mask(t, xyz)
first_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
expected = reference(t, xyz)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(got, expected)

times = []
for _ in range(7):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    got = motion_mask(t, xyz)
    times.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(got, expected)
print(f\"samples={len(t)} output_dtype={got.dtype} exact_match=True\")
print(f\"first_call_ms={first_ms:.3f}\")
print(f\"warmed_ms_median={np.median(times):.3f} warmed_ms_min={min(times):.3f}\")
